To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the predominant pathway in CSR is NHEJ and that this pathway is initiated by the recruitment of the DNA damage sensors or adaptors to the S region breaks, leading to the recruitment of the classical NHEJ components.
the NHEJ machinery is involved in CSR and that the A-EJ machinery is involved, too.
NHEJ is the predominant pathway in CSR.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the elucidation of the molecular mechanism of CSR and the role of NHEJ in this process.
the mechanisms of DNA repair, particularly non-homologues end joining, in class switch recombining B cells.
the elucidation of the molecular mechanisms underlying CSR, which is an essential part of the humoral immune response.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NHEJ plays an important role in the repair of the DSBs generated during CSR.

, in CSR, the initial DSBs are recognized and processed by the NHEJ machinery and the A-EJ machinery is probably involved in repairing the DSBs that are not processed by the Nhej machinery, or in completing the repair process.
NHEJ is a major pathway in CSR, although the exact mechanism and the exact contribution of the individual components are still under investigation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NHEJ in CSR is a complex process involving multiple DNA-damage-sensing and repair factors, but that the exact order of events and the exact role of each component remain unclear.

NHEJ in the context of CSR is a complex, multistep process, which involves the recruitment of DNA-damage response factors, such as γH2AX and 53BP1 and the activation of DNA-damage checkpoint kinases, such as ATR.
the NHEJ machinery has been recruited for the repair of the DSBs in CSR and that the repair of the breaks requires the participation of the DNA-damage sensors and/or adaptors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NHEJ is not only a repair mechanism, but also an editing pathway in CSR, as it is in V(D)J recombination.

NHEJ in CSR is not a ‘classical’ repair pathway, as it requires additional components, and that it is a very efficient pathway, as it is able to rejoin DSBs that are not compatible with the classical pathway.
CSR is a complex process that requires a number of DNA damage sensors and repair factors to ensure the proper repair of DSBs and the recombination between S regions.
